name: My Zypp Stikks 1g Infused Preroll - Biscotti Pop
description:
Infused and ready to spark. The My Zypp Stikks Biscotti Pop is a 1-gram infused pre-roll packed with quality flower for a bolder, more potent smoke. No grinding, no rolling, just light it and go.

Biscotti Pop brings a rich, dessert-forward profile: sweet biscotti cookie and vanilla notes up front, layered with a candy-sweet edge and a smooth, subtly earthy finish.

1G infused pre-roll — quality flower infused for extra potency
Signature Biscotti Pop flavor — sweet cookie and vanilla with a candy finish
Ready to enjoy — no setup, no battery, just light and go

My Zypp Stikks Biscotti Pop is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
